info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Banking Enterprise Services Security Advisorys-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Enterprise Services Security Advisory API provides a comprehensive listing of security advisory resources related to banking enterprise services. This endpoint is used to retrieve critical security information and updates to help businesses safeguard their operations against vulnerabilities. Typical consumers include banking institutions, compliance teams, and IT security personnel who require timely access to advisory content for risk management. Utilize this API to stay informed about security threats and best practices in the banking sector.

get.summary: Retrieve security advisory information for enterprise services.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed security advisory information related to enterprise services, enabling organizations to stay informed about potential vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding security advisories within the enterprise services. It specifically handles queries to fetch details like advisory identifiers, severity levels, and affected components. Ensure that the appropriate criteria are specified to narrow down the results.

200.description: The request was successful and the returned data is available.

ListBankingEnterpriseServicesSecurityAdv.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the security advisory within enterprise services.

items.description: An array of security advisory engagement items.

sort.description: Sorting parameter to order the list of items.
